dos.text: Leave label empty if you want the built-in Fluent text, since labelL10nId only supplies "moz-badge-beta2"/"moz-badge-new2" strings for type="beta"/"new" when there is no explicit label to override it.

donts.text: Don't expect the title attribute to behave like a normal reflected tooltip afterward, MozLitElement's mapped-attribute handling moves it into an internal titleAttribute and clears the host attribute the first time it's set, and per lit-utils.mjs's own comment the attribute can not be unset once it is set.
